title: EasyGUI-Fuchsi
description:
A simple and performant Paper plugin that puts 5 commands into a GUI.
Items and commands can be easily customized
body:
# EasyGUI

**EasyGUI** is a performant Paper/Spigot plugin that allows you to conveniently execute 5 different commands via a GUI (inventory menu).

Both the commands and the appearance of the GUI can be fully customized in the `config.yml`.  
This file is automatically generated when the plugin is started for the first time.

### ⚠️ Notice about the default config
In the default generated config, commands from the following plugins are used (you can of course change them!):
* [EconomyShopGUI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/economyshopgui.69927/)
* [SimpleTeleport](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simpleteleports)

---

### 🐛 Bugs & Features
Please be understanding if you encounter any bugs – **this is my very first plugin!** 🥳  
If you find bugs or have feature requests, feel free to contact me. I will do my best to implement them.
